layout_rules: USB and SDIO series footprints are branch-local and are never placed on the C5 common segment shared by GPIO13/GPIO14.
DAT2/DAT3 pull-ups stay on HSD2 so they cannot bias USB D+/D- in service mode.
CLK has no fitted pull-up; keep only a DNP diagnostic footprint and the independent series tuning footprint.
Route each differential USB branch as 90-ohm differential and length-match within the final stack-up rule; avoid stubs at the mux.
Place every source-series option close to the active source for the direction being qualified; bidirectional SDIO values are finalized by SI/HIL, not assumed from schematic alone.

edge_straps.selected_profile: rising-edge input sample, falling-edge output drive
edge_straps.jtag_policy: GPIO7 is externally pulled high for SDIO. Production eFuse and recovery policy must use USB-JTAG or disabled JTAG and must never depend on a floating GPIO7 or a conflicting pad-JTAG strap.

service_vbus.hardware_requirement: An always-on hardware detector and asynchronous latch must seize service ownership without C5 or Hub firmware.

detector.topology: C5 service VBUS -> 1-Mohm top resistor -> MOSFET gate; 1-Mohm gate-to-ground resistor; source to ground; drain is SERVICE_VBUS_PRESENT_N with an AON 10-kohm pull-up
detector.proof: The only service-VBUS DC path is the 2-Mohm divider to ground and the insulated MOSFET gate. No semiconductor junction or product rail is connected to service VBUS. Valid USB VBUS gives at least 2.351 V at the gate, above the exact device's 1.8-V RDS(on) test point; presence therefore pulls the active-low detector node hard low before any application domain is released.

used_gate.function: four-input NAND; CLR_N can go low only when VBUS is absent and all three release proofs are high

release_qualifier.unused_gate: tie all four inputs to SAFETY_GROUND; leave the deterministic-high output unconnected

invariants: PRE_N and CLR_N cannot both be low because SERVICE_VBUS_PRESENT_N is both PRE_N and one input of the clear NAND.
C5, Hub and mux remain in the global AON-POR safe shell until either asynchronous preset or qualified clear has established a valid ownership state.
No C5, Hub or S3 firmware output reaches PRE_N, CLR_N or the VBUS detector.
The explicit AON release request is necessary but cannot clear ownership unless VBUS absence, C5 EN low and Hub SDIO high-Z are simultaneously proven in hardware.
detector_latch_implementation.release_rule: Accepted for native R2 schematic use. Recheck every exact JLC number, Standard-PCBA eligibility, stock/explicit route, MOQ and price at architecture freeze and immediately before the exact-one order.

latch.clear_condition: service VBUS absent AND C5 EN asserted low AND Hub SDIO pins proven high-impedance AND explicit AON service-release request
service_override: force C5 EN low during switch
force mux OE high during branch change
